name: MOONBOY Voice v2 (authentic)

primary_engine.why: Higgsfield seed_audio + v2 element: sim 0.76-0.82 to the authentic voice.

identity_source.separation: Higgsfield separate_stems (htdemucs, mode two) in the Higgsfield sandbox
identity_source.authentic_clip: studio/voice/identity/authentic_voice_ref.mp3 (9.7 s, ONLY real MOONBOY speech: 'Uh-oh', 'Not on my watch!', 'Gotcha!', 'Safe and sound.', effort sound) — Higgsfield media 5cd7db21-913a-4e63-8f69-c5d7c8a097e1

acoustic_target.character: young male cartoon, playful, vintage American cartoon delivery, clear US English

performance_rules: Write the line exactly as spoken; punctuation drives delivery ('!' energy, '...' pauses, '?' lift).
Plain text prompts work best with the voice element; do not add stage directions to the text (they get spoken).
Non-verbal: sneeze = 'Ah... Ahh... ACHOO!' with the approved sneeze take as @Audio 2 performance reference (job f1ea6508-377f-4fc5-8b87-c30265001c1c or studio/voice/library/sneeze_ref.wav).
Generate >=2 takes per line, auto-select with studio/tools/voice_qc.py (correct transcript AND F0 in target AND highest similarity).

MOONBOY Voice v1.reason: Built partly from AI takes at ~420 Hz due to a pitch-estimation error (music bleed in a local stem). Do not use.

lip_sync_pipeline: Generate the talking shot in Higgsfield video (model speaks the line with generate_audio=true, dialogue/voice reference as audio_references) -> Higgsfield voice_change with the v2 element (keeps timing: envelope corr 0.96 in test) -> lips stay in sync with the MOONBOY voice.
